mapper.sql: (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM work_log w WHERE w.farm_id=f.id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.work_date>=#{start} AND w.work_date<#{endExclusive}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pest_control_log p WHERE p.farm_id=f.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.apply_date>=#{start} AND p.apply_date<#{endExclusive}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM harvest_log h WHERE h.farm_id=f.id AND h.deleted_at IS NULL AND h.harvest_date>=#{start} AND h.harvest_date<#{endExclusive}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_log s WHERE s.farm_id=f.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.sales_date>=#{start} AND s.sales_date<#{endExclusive}))

f.id,f.farm_code,f.name,f.address,f.lifecycle_status,f.status, f.owner_user_id,owner.display_name owner_display_name,owner.email owner_email, c.id main_crop_id,c.name main_crop_name,f.created_at,f.updated_at

FROM farm f JOIN users owner ON owner.id=f.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN farm_crop fc ON fc.id=( SELECT fc2.id FROM farm_crop fc2 WHERE fc2.farm_id=f.id AND fc2.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY fc2.display_order ASC,fc2.crop_id ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN crop c ON c.id=fc.crop_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm_member fm WHERE fm.farm_id=f.id AND fm.status='ACTIVE') active_member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm_zone z WHERE z.farm_id=f.id AND z.active_yn='Y' AND z.deleted_at IS NULL) active_zone_count
WHERE f.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND f.id=#{farmId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT farm_id,LOWER(TRIM(unit)) unit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date>=#{currentStart} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) current_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date<#{currentStart} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) previous_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date>=#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date<#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) previous_count FROM harvest_log WHERE farm_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND harvest_date>=#{previousStart} AND harvest_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY farm_id,LOWER(TRIM(unit)) ORDER BY farm_id,unit

SELECT farm_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_gross, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_fee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_net, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_gross, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_fee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_net, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) previous_count FROM sales_log WHERE farm_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND sales_date>=#{previousStart} AND sales_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY farm_id ORDER BY farm_id

SELECT farm_id,LOWER(TRIM(unit)) unit,SUM(quantity) sold_quantity,SUM(gross_amount) gross_sales_amount FROM sales_log WHERE farm_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND sales_date>=#{start} AND sales_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY farm_id,LOWER(TRIM(unit)) HAVING SUM(quantity)>0 ORDER BY farm_id,unit
